versions.name: Personal Fitness
versions.description: Measure your own aerobic capacity, strength, and flexibility, log what you eat, then follow a twelve-week program of warm-ups, cardio, strength work, and stretching and retest to see what actually improved.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
